title: Special Executive Programme In International Trade Law
description: Explore the legal frameworks governing international trade and the roles of key institutions like the WTO.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme covers essential topics relating to international trade and international sales contracts. First, this course explores international trade's legal and regulatory landscape and how this practice can negatively and positively impact economies, societies, and the environment. In addition, the course introduces some fundamental concepts, reflects on relevant market theories, and then presents an in-depth analysis of complex international trade agreements and mechanisms, including GATT and WTO. Second, the course explores the English legal and regulatory landscape of the sales of goods and the principles on which law practitioners draft and negotiate these contracts.
courseDetails: The course begins by examining the influence of international trade on global economies and environmental factors, as well as market theories. Participants will study the roles and functions of the World Trade Organization, the structure of sales contracts under English law, and the rights and obligations of parties in international sales. The programme also covers remedies for contract breaches, the application of incoterms rules, and key provisions of the Vienna Convention (CISG). outcomes: Measure the impact of international trade on economies and the environment.
Understand the structure, role, and function of the world trade organisation.
Understand the construction of contracts of sales of goods and products in English law.
Determine the rights and obligations of buyer and seller in international sales contracts.
Reflect on the remedies offered to the buyer and seller in case of breach of contract.
Understand the different types and effects of incoterms rules.
Reflect on the scope and provisions of the Vienna Convention for the international sale of goods.
Understand the obligations of the seller and buyer under the CISG.
Analyse remedies offered to the buyer and seller under the CISG.
Reflect on the economic foundations of international sales contracts.
Understand the function of foreign exchange markets.
Understand various methods of payment in international trade.
